status: Exact symmetric equilibria with all-time orbit confinement · Local stability criteria · Not a coil-produced stellarator · Not a construction release.

slides.eyebrow: Progress briefing · alphas confined in a stellarator field
slides.title: Alpha guiding centres confined forever — over a whole range of field strengths.
slides.lead: PlasmaLean is building a Lean library for stellarator design. In an exact non-axisymmetric stellarator field, field lines and passing 3.5 MeV alpha guiding centres (μ = 0, either sign of v∥) are proved confined for all time — now for every B₀R₀ in a ±1.5% range, not just one value; a coil set confines field lines for 52 transits; one axisymmetric plasma has proved alpha confinement, a hot core and certified local stability.

metrics.label: B₀R₀ range with all-time alpha guiding-centre confinement
certified transits for a coil-produced field

slides.progress: All-time field-line confinement in a genuine stellarator field (vacuum model); one consistent axisymmetric plasma with certified local stability; coil-produced confinement for one transit.
slides.boundary: Alpha results: μ = 0 only, Littlejohn model supplied, vacuum model field; trapped near-QA alphas only 1.8×10⁻⁴ s; coil-produced all-time confinement blocked; the only Mercier-stable finite-β non-axisymmetric band is low-β with hand-derived flux labels.

slides.eyebrow: 01 · How the library earns a claim
slides.title: Small assumptions. Reusable proofs. One candidate.
slides.lead: Physical model laws are explicit hypotheses. Derived mathematics and candidate certificates live above that small domain kernel.

cards.title: Kernel + Sanity
cards.text: Restricted equilibrium and thermal laws, consistent examples, and counterexamples to overbroad claims.

cards.title: Theory
cards.text: Geometry, fields and Maxwell identities, equilibrium, Suydam/Newcomb stability, Noether confinement and thermal consequences.

cards.title: Certificates + Bridge
cards.text: Exact arithmetic, sound checkers and contracts that require the same candidate and witnesses.

cards.title: Design
cards.text: The vacuum-pair fixture, a Suydam-stable screw pinch, and exact Solov'ev and helical equilibria with confinement theorems exercise the reusable library.

slides.progress: The public library separates all six layers. The last audit found only Lean/Mathlib's standard logical axioms, with no added domain axioms.
slides.boundary: A theorem proves a consequence of a model; it does not establish that empirical assumptions apply to a real machine.

slides.title: The foundations have executable proof content.
slides.lead: Simple models make the definitions testable before tackling three-dimensional plasma physics.

cards.title: Equilibrium
cards.text: Force balance implies field/current tangency to pressure. Uniform and nonzero-current force-free slab examples provide witnesses.

cards.title: Energy & stability
cards.text: Conditional energy conservation, coercivity and retained/tail form bounds. A neutral-mode example shows why energy need not control displacement.

cards.title: Geometry & fields
cards.text: Continuous clearance, arbitrarily placed circular coils, Biot–Savart integrals and an exact on-axis loop field.

slides.progress: These are compiled elementary results and sanity checks, not just declarations of future tasks.
slides.boundary: Zero pressure does not imply zero current. Abstract energy bounds do not yet establish a continuum MHD stability result.

slides.title: From a numerical proposal to a proved bound.
slides.lead: Rational interval soundness and contraction arguments give small end-to-end tests of the verification path.

cards.title: Nonlinear validation
cards.text: A scalar x² = 2 example on [1, 2] exercises the contraction framework with exact constants.

cards.title: Thermal margin
cards.text: A slab boundary-value problem has a whole-input-box maximum of 44002/45 K, with 998/45 K margin below an invented 1000 K limit.

cards.title: Sound arithmetic
cards.text: Exact coefficient decoding and interval/checker proofs separate candidate generation from the trusted proof path.

slides.progress: Exact arithmetic is connected to mathematical soundness theorems and explicit test fixtures.
slides.boundary: The scalar example is not a plasma PDE solution. The thermal inputs are invented, not sourced material qualification data.

slides.title: Two circular coils. Precisely stated regions.
slides.lead: The first device-specific object is a calibration fixture with symbolic positive reference current I and permeability μ₀. Its field model uses ideal filaments.

cards.title: Nominal geometry
cards.text: Each coil has radius 0.10 m, in the planes z = ±0.20 m, with the same angular orientation.

cards.title: Two different regions
cards.text: Field/error/derivative bounds cover the 5 cm observation ball. The positive axial-field certificate covers the smaller 1 mm probe ball.

slides.progress: Closure, regularity, one-turn simplicity, source separation and the nominal midpoint field have proofs.
slides.boundary: The diagram is schematic, not a field-line simulation or a construction drawing. Neither ball is a certified confinement region.

slides.title: Margins for the same perturbed coils and currents.
slides.lead: Assume closed C¹ coils with position error ≤ 1 mm, independent tangent error ≤ 1 mm/radian, and independent current errors ≤ 1% of I.

cards.title: Field error
cards.text: Actual minus nominal field has norm at most μ₀I/4 throughout the 5 cm observation ball (SI lengths in metres).

cards.title: Nonzero probe field
cards.text: The actual axial component is at least μ₀I/4 throughout the 1 mm probe ball, for μ₀ > 0 and I > 0.

cards.title: Tube clearance
cards.text: The two 5 mm-radius envelopes around actual coil centrelines remain at least 97/250 m = 388 mm apart.

slides.progress: Manufacturing and current errors compose into continuous field and clearance certificates, not just sampled checks.
slides.boundary: These tolerances are invented test inputs. Tube envelopes do not prove embedded winding packs or a finite-conductor electromagnetic model.

slides.title: Maxwell identities proved; interchange stability decided both ways.
slides.lead: The closed-filament Biot–Savart field is divergence- and curl-free off the coil. A sharp Hardy inequality gives the Suydam criterion with both sufficiency and an explicit unstable mode.

cards.title: ∇·B = 0, ∇×B = 0
cards.text: For the actual Fréchet derivative of the continuous filament integral, away from the source; curl needs a closed curve, and the open-segment curl is computed exactly.

cards.title: Suydam, both directions
cards.text: F ≥ 0, F + 4G ≥ 0 gives a coercive margin; F + 4G < 0 gives an unstable localized mode in every neighbourhood of the resonance. Hardy's constant 4 is sharp.

cards.title: Newcomb certificates
cards.text: Picone/Riccati/Jacobi certificates for variable coefficients, discharged by an exact rational polynomial checker running in the kernel.

slides.progress: A realistic screw pinch (a = 1 m, R₀ = 4 m, 5 T, ⟨β⟩ = 2/75) satisfies Suydam everywhere with a 25% margin, and Newcomb-reduced δW ≥ 0 is certified for every mode with 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 (wall at the edge); Phase 2 extended this to every integer (m, n) with m ≠ 0 (ScrewPinchModesHighM).
slides.boundary: The δW reductions are cited source results, not formalized; the all-mode result is for this cylindrical screw pinch only. Suydam alone is necessary, not sufficient.

slides.title: Two exact equilibria satisfy the kernel law J × B = ∇p.
slides.lead: The current is computed as curl B/μ₀ from actual derivatives and checked against the unchanged kernel ForceBalance class.

cards.title: Solov'ev torus
cards.text: Axisymmetric (tokamak-like) exact equilibrium; ITER-like instance R₀ = 6 m, B = 5 T, β_axis = 147/5000; div B = 0, flux and current tangent to surfaces.

cards.title: Helical equilibrium
cards.text: Helically symmetric, nonaxisymmetric exact equilibrium found by symbolic search; SI instance with pitch length 2 m, B = 5 T, β_axis = 4%.

cards.title: Model limits
cards.text: Straight helix (no toroidal curvature); smooth pressure formula restricted to ψ ≤ ψ_b; neither field is matched to coils.

slides.progress: P4 now has checked smooth instances at realistic field strength and β.
slides.boundary: No free-boundary or coil matching. Phase 4 added local (Mercier) findings — the helical equilibrium is Mercier-unstable, the Solov'ev q ≥ 2.02 — but there is no all-mode stability analysis of these equilibria yet.

slides.title: Symmetry plus Noether confines every slow enough orbit forever.
slides.lead: Canonical momentum m⟨K,v⟩ + qψ is conserved for any Killing symmetry K; with speed conservation and an intermediate-value argument, orbits stay in a flux region for all time.

cards.title: Solov'ev orbits
cards.text: Deuterons up to 400 keV starting in the inner region never leave the plasma torus.

cards.title: Helical orbits
cards.text: Deuterons ≤ 30 keV and alphas ≤ 60 keV stay at r < 0.71 m inside the 4% β plasma, for all time.

cards.title: Broken symmetry
cards.text: A symmetry defect δ gives confinement only for times ∝ 1/(δ|v|) — ballistic, far from slowing-down times. This bound does not cover 3.5 MeV alphas (see Phases 3–4).

slides.progress: P3 has checked full-orbit instances; field lines are confined by exact first integrals.
slides.boundary: Orbits are supplied, not constructed. Guiding-centre averaging for near-quasisymmetric fields was formalized later (AveragedTrapping: passing alphas for 0.11 s in a supplied guiding-centre model); all-time confinement without exact symmetry is not proved.

slides.eyebrow: 09 · From idealized models to a stellarator
slides.title: The remaining device work is explicit.
slides.lead: The vacuum-fixture work packages remain, now joined by an equilibrium/stability track. A four-circular-coil, CNT-inspired architecture is a reference direction, not a certified design.

cards.title: VD1 · Freeze the candidate
cards.text: Version the four coil placements, frames, radii, turns/current conventions and leads against a source dataset.

cards.title: VD2 · Continuous fields
cards.text: Maxwell identities are proved for closed filaments; extend fixture geometry/derivative work to the candidate coil set.

cards.title: VD3–4 · Conductors & confinement
cards.text: Model embedded finite winding packs, then certify an invariant barrier or a declared finite-time orbit bundle.

cards.title: VD5 · Physical operation
cards.text: Source conductor, supply, thermal, mechanical, protection and metrology envelopes for that same candidate.

slides.progress: Reusable mathematics now spans fields, equilibria, local stability and symmetric confinement. No practical build or energization specification has been released.
slides.boundary: Finite-pressure equilibrium, all-mode MHD, transport and reactor engineering are separate obligations, not implied by a vacuum demonstrator; so far they are checked only in idealized symmetric models (slides 7–13).

slides.title: A burning plasma that provably stays above 10 keV.
slides.lead: A reactor-scale 0-D D-T plasma (n = 10²⁰ m⁻³, 830 m³, carbon impurities with Z_eff = 1.7) stays at or above 10 keV for all t ≥ 0 once heating beats losses at 10 keV. Radial transport obeys a proved comparison principle, so a barrier profile bounds the temperature everywhere for all time.

cards.title: Sustained burn (M1)
cards.text: T ≥ 10 keV for all t ≥ 0 with P_aux ≥ 40 MW and τ_E ≥ 3.5 s whenever T ≤ 10 keV: margin +5.5 MW. Ignited variant: τ_E ≥ 5.5 s, no auxiliary power. Yield ≥ 4.8×10⁸ W × t_b.

cards.title: Runaway is real
cards.text: With constant τ_E, net heating is +77 MW at 30 keV. The window [10, 30] keV is proved only under a supplied confinement-degradation hypothesis (τ_E ≤ 1.8 s for T ≥ 30 keV).

cards.title: Transport comparison (T3)
cards.text: First-crossing lemma and comparison theorems for the flux-surface heat equation with a no-flux axis: strict, margin and non-strict lower/upper barriers, and two-sided windows. D ≥ 0 suffices; backward diffusion is a counterexample.

cards.title: Vacuum maximum principle (T1)
cards.text: Δ|B|² = 2|∇B|² for vacuum fields; the weak maximum principle bounds the field error in the volume by its value on the surface. |B| has no interior maximum, but B = (x, y, −2z) has an interior minimum, correcting the notes.

slides.progress: 13 new modules, including kernel laws for fusion power, radial transport and vacuum fields, each with sanity checks. An adversarial review caught a fuel-dilution error in the first M1 version; the kernel and the margins were corrected.
slides.boundary: Bosch–Hale reactivity enters as supplied windows (±1%). τ_E conditions are hypotheses at the crossing temperatures, not derived from a scaling law. Transport solutions are supplied, not proved to exist.

slides.eyebrow: 11 · Phase 2: a core that stays hot
slides.title: Every solution starting above the barrier keeps a 10 keV core forever.
slides.lead: For the flux-surface heat equation with alpha heating, bremsstrahlung and ≈70 MW of deposited heating, a certified barrier profile bounds the temperature from below for all time. A 0-D burn window now follows from the IPB98(y,2) confinement scaling instead of ad-hoc confinement-time assumptions.

cards.title: Core barrier (M2)
cards.text: For every supplied reactivity in the Bosch–Hale class and χ ≤ 0.5 m²/s: T ≥ T_sub ≥ 10 keV on the inner 30% of the flux, for all t ≥ 0. The barrier is a degree-10 polynomial with a 16-piece exact margin certificate.

cards.title: Scaling-law burn (M1)
cards.text: With IPB98(y,2) for an ITER-like tokamak, P_aux ∈ [50, 70] MW and H ∈ [1.25, 2], T stays in [10, 30] keV. At nominal H the flat-profile model cannot hold 10 keV (proved). The ignition point is in (12, 13) keV and is unstable.

cards.title: All-mode screw pinch
cards.text: Newcomb stability for every integer (m, n) with m ≠ 0: stability is monotone in m², and an analytic Picone function closes the open band. Barta ballooning certificates; cylindrical Mercier ⇔ Suydam.

cards.title: Min-B obstruction
cards.text: In vacuum ∇⊥|B| = |B|κ, so no closed field line carries a transverse minimum of |B|. A straight-wire field is the witness. Coil fields are proved C^∞ off the coil.

slides.progress: 14 new modules. Reviews found no soundness bugs and led to guards for shearless Mercier surfaces, a non-vacuity witness for the obstruction, and clarified χ normalization and corner compatibility.
slides.boundary: The barrier is in a straight cylinder, not a stellarator geometry; χ and density are prescribed; solutions are supplied. The kernel's D ≥ D_min > 0 had to be bypassed at the axis; Phase 3 relaxed the kernel to D ≥ 0 with a degenerate axis, making the cylinder a direct kernel instance.

slides.title: Every 3.5 MeV alpha born in the core stays in — forever.
slides.lead: In an exact equilibrium satisfying J × B = ∇p at 5 T and β ≈ 4.6%, every fusion alpha with energy ≤ 3.5 MeV starting in the inner quarter of the flux, with any pitch, stays inside the plasma for all time under the full Lorentz force. The margin is 1.5%: the same argument fails at 3.7 MeV.

cards.title: Alpha confinement
cards.text: Noether's canonical momentum plus a rigidity bound (m s/2e ≤ 0.2694 < 0.2734 T·m). An explicit orbit shows the hypotheses can be met. The equilibrium is axisymmetric (tokamak-like).

cards.title: Hot core, helical geometry
cards.text: On the exact helically symmetric equilibrium: T ≥ 10 keV on s ≤ 0.3 for all time, 63–68 MW of heating, axis pressure below the equilibrium's. The transport kernel now allows a degenerate axis (D ≥ 0). Phase 4 found this helical equilibrium Mercier-unstable, so the geometry is not MHD-stable.

cards.title: Stellarator burn needs confinement
cards.text: At Stellaris scale under ISS04, T stays in [10, 22] keV if f_ren ∈ [1.55, 1.75]; at measured f_ren ≤ 1.3 the flat-profile model cannot reach 10 keV (proved).

cards.title: Validation & near-symmetry
cards.text: Radii polynomial on ℓ¹: a nonlinear BVP solved within 10⁻⁴. Near-axis QA: passing alphas trapped 0.8 ms, with an iterated averaging lemma and gyro-Noether identity proved as the route to slowing-down times.

slides.progress: 15 new modules and a recorded kernel change. Three review passes: pressure consistency of the barrier, a finite-time Boozer orbit structure, a kernel law excluding vacuous regular axes, and non-vacuity witnesses.
slides.boundary: The alpha theorem is for an axisymmetric equilibrium; near-quasisymmetric fields reached only 0.8 ms in this phase (0.11 s in Phase 4). Flux-surface averages, scaling laws, reactivity and solutions are supplied. No coil-produced configuration.

slides.title: From 0.8 ms to 0.11 s — and a plasma equilibrium validated to 10⁻¹¹.
slides.lead: Iterating an oscillatory averaging lemma three times, with exact Lie-derivative amplitudes and certified enclosures, extends passing-alpha confinement in a reactor-scale near-axis quasisymmetric field from 0.8 ms to 0.11 s. A slab Grad–Shafranov equilibrium with an exponential pressure profile is validated by the radii polynomial and proved to satisfy the kernel force balance.

cards.title: Near-QA alphas: 0.11 s
cards.text: Passing 3.5 MeV alphas (|v∥/v| ≥ 0.9) at a = 1.7 m, 5.7 T stay inside for 0.11 s; the same gap fails at 0.12 s. Slowing down takes ≈ 0.4 s, so a ≈ 4× gap remains.

cards.title: Validated equilibrium
cards.text: P(ψ) ∝ e^ψ − ψ: a classical C² slab equilibrium within 10⁻¹¹ of a rational candidate, unique nearby in ℓ¹, satisfying StaticSlab and ForceBalance with positive pressure.

cards.title: Stability findings
cards.text: The general Mercier index reduces to Suydam in a cylinder. The helical equilibrium is Mercier-unstable (proved at a = 0). For the Solov'ev reactor equilibrium the true safety factor is ≥ 2.02 everywhere.

cards.title: Coils and coupling
cards.text: Face samples certify the coil field error in a whole volume (maximum principle + surface cover). One consistent plasma needs an upper temperature barrier — and so a T-dependent diffusivity in the kernel.

slides.progress: 12 new modules. Reviews found an oracle factor-of-2 error (corrected; conclusion unchanged) and no soundness defects in the averaged-trapping theorem; its ≈ 6 min build is scheduled for a proof-term rewrite.
slides.boundary: Guiding-centre model supplied; near-axis field accurate only to expansion order; passing alphas only; the validated equilibrium is a 1-D slab; the helical barrier geometry is MHD-unstable.

slides.title: Confinement and heat, proved for the same plasma.
slides.lead: solovev_one_plasma: one exact field satisfying J × B = ∇p; every 3.5 MeV alpha born in the core stays inside forever; every solution of the transport law starting in a certified band keeps a ≥ 10 keV core forever; and the plasma pressure never exceeds the equilibrium pressure plus an edge offset.

cards.title: One plasma
cards.text: Same field, same pressure, same domain s ≤ 1 for force balance, alpha confinement and the transport band. Driven (≈ 120 MW aux, Q ≈ 5.5); transport geometry via a supplied class (proved for the actual field in Phase 6).

cards.title: Temperature-dependent χ (K2)
cards.text: The kernel now allows D(ψ,T); comparison theorems extend and upper barriers are proved directly. A cylinder band keeps 10 keV ≤ T ≤ 23.5 keV in the core.

cards.title: Mercier stability certified
cards.text: The exact axisymmetric Mercier index of the reactor Solov'ev equilibrium is positive on every flux surface (validated quadrature, 3–6% margins); a genuine magnetic well is proved.

cards.title: Near-QA alphas: 0.19 s
cards.text: Proof-term certificates cut the build from 349 s to 59 s and extended passing-alpha confinement from 0.11 s to 0.19 s — about half the slowing-down time. Trapped alphas: single-well and bounce-sum lemmas.

slides.progress: 8 new modules and kernel change K2. A sub-agent report that claimed non-existent geometry lemmas was caught at integration; every cited declaration is now grep-checked.
slides.boundary: Supplied geometry class (being proved), driven parameters, χ stand-in, axisymmetric equilibrium, supplied solutions; near-QA results rest on the guiding-centre model.

slides.eyebrow: 15 · Phase 6: true geometry, ignition, stellarator field
slides.title: No supplied geometry, no auxiliary power — and a genuine stellarator field.
slides.lead: The one-plasma theorem now uses flux-surface quantities computed from the equilibrium itself. With quarter-keV reactivity data it certifies a high-Q (Q ≈ 40) band and an ignited band with zero auxiliary heating. Separately, an exact rational vacuum field with two field periods and stellarator symmetry gives the library its first non-axisymmetric stellarator geometry.

cards.title: Actual geometry
cards.text: V′, ⟨|∇s|²⟩, ⟨Δs⟩ from the exact surfaces; Gauss identity and axis limits proved; enclosures with 0.26% margins. The coarea step was stated here and is proved in Phase 7.

cards.title: High-Q and ignited
cards.text: 17.5 MW aux (oracle Q ≈ 39–46) with a 40 kPa edge offset; zero aux with a 90 kPa offset (≈ 20% of axis pressure, an edge pedestal) and a ±0.8% χ₀ window.

cards.title: Ballooning
cards.text: Every field line and ballooning angle stable on four near-axis Solov'ev surfaces, via a 2-D Riccati certificate on the exact coefficients.

cards.title: Rational stellarator
cards.text: B = ∇φ + ε∇h: exact vacuum, 2 periods, stellarator-symmetric, non-axisymmetric; closed circular axis with elliptic monodromy. Certified confinement (≥ 95 transits) added in Phase 7.

slides.progress: 13 new modules; review found no bugs (fine windows and geometry bounds independently recomputed). Trapped near-QA alphas: turning points proved, non-resonance open — a real resonance exists in the band.
slides.boundary: Axisymmetric integrated results; ignition needs a large edge offset; supplied stability reductions; the stellarator field is not yet confined over a certified length or produced by coils.

slides.title: 95 toroidal transits, certified, in a genuine stellarator field.
slides.lead: For the exact vacuum field B = ∇φ + ¼∇h — non-axisymmetric, two field periods, stellarator-symmetric — every field line starting within ≈ 0.023 R₀ of the magnetic axis stays within ≈ 0.1 R₀ of it for at least 95 full toroidal transits. And the coarea formula closes the last stated link in the one-plasma theorem.

cards.title: Stellarator confinement
cards.text: An order-10 approximate first integral with |DI·B| ≤ 4×10⁻⁶ on the whole tube, certified by an exact-integer Taylor-shift cover; I separates start tube from tube faces; the defect theorem converts this into ≥ 95 transits.

cards.title: Coarea formalized
cards.text: Injective coordinates, null axis, Jacobian √2σ/R, Lebesgue volume = coordinate volume, and d/ds ∫ f = ∮ f dS/|∇s|: the flux-surface averages in the transport law are proved, not stated.

cards.title: Still open
cards.text: Coils for the stellarator field (error must stay below the defect budget); all-time confinement (KAM); trapped near-QA alphas; ballooning beyond four surfaces.

slides.progress: 7 new modules; review found the certificate sound (exact margins, symmetry reduction and face coverage checked) and led to a local field-line version and fuller disclosures.
slides.boundary: Finite-length, vacuum-field result; no coils; the cover uses monolithic kernel checks (≈ 5 GB peak memory, accepted by review).

slides.title: Stable on every surface; from coil error to confined field lines.
slides.lead: Ideal ballooning is certified on every flux surface of the reactor equilibrium, axis to edge. For the exact stellarator field, a concrete closed filament reproduces the toroidal part to 2.5×10⁻⁶, and any coil set whose helical error on a bounding surface is below 6.5×10⁻⁴ (or 5.6×10⁻⁵) inherits 1 (or 10) certified transits.

cards.title: Ballooning everywhere
cards.text: One s-polynomial certificate over 825 boxes (proof-term cover, ≈ 1 min build) gives stability on all surfaces 0 < s ≤ 25 for every field line and ballooning angle; the axis is handled analytically.

cards.title: Coil chain
cards.text: Certified TF filament; maximum principle carries a frontier error into the confinement tube; certified gradient bound converts error into transits. The helical-winding frontier bound (sampled 2.4×10⁻⁴ for 120 filaments) is not yet certified.
cards.status: Lean verified up to one hypothesis

cards.title: Trapped alphas
cards.text: Exact QA: bounce precession enclosed in [0.7, 2.6] rad — non-resonant — and the reference bounce proved periodic. No confinement time yet: the near-QA remainder is open.

slides.progress: 33 new modules (many certificate cells). The ballooning certificate was rebuilt as a proof-term cover; the trapped-alpha cell checks still await that rewrite.
slides.boundary: Supplied stability reductions; vacuum finite-length stellarator result; one coil hypothesis open; trapped near-QA alphas open.

slides.eyebrow: 18 · Phase 8: finite β beyond axisymmetry; one torus to go
slides.title: Finite pressure without axisymmetry — and all-time confinement from one torus.
slides.lead: Landreman's family-1 equilibrium satisfies the kernel force balance with finite pressure, is genuinely non-axisymmetric with a non-planar axis, and has all field lines closed and confined. For the exact stellarator vacuum field, any invariant torus traps every field line inside it forever.

cards.title: Finite-β, non-axisymmetric
cards.text: J × B = ∇p with the actual current; ψ a flux function; explicit closed field lines; 5 T instance with local axis β 6–8%. Zero shear (ι ≡ 2); unrefereed source; no stability claim.

cards.title: One torus suffices
cards.text: A Grönwall barrier around {G = 0} and a radial-graph invariant torus trap field lines for all time; for the rational stellarator field this reduces all-time confinement to producing one torus.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: A validated approximate torus (K2), an explicit-constant KAM theorem (K3, the long pole), a certified helical coil set, and Landreman family 2 with shear.

slides.progress: 3 new modules and two theory notes; a discovery-note error about the family-1 axis was caught and corrected by the formalization.
slides.boundary: Idealized finite-β equilibrium; conditional all-time confinement; no coil-produced confined stellarator yet.

slides.title: A certified approximate torus and the first KAM lemmas.
slides.lead: Torus A — a 2-D Fourier embedding with rational coefficients — solves the field-line invariance equation of the exact stellarator field to 10⁻²³ for all angles, and is a radial graph around the magnetic axis. The Diophantine and cohomological lemmas of KAM theory are proved with explicit constants.

cards.title: Approximate torus (K2)
cards.text: Exact ℓ¹ norm of the residual's Fourier coefficients via Kronecker digit sums: ≤ 1.23×10⁻²³ (R), 6.94×10⁻²⁴ (z); 0.077 ≤ r ≤ 0.19.

cards.title: KAM lemmas (K3a)
cards.text: Diophantine γ = 0.1374 (τ = 1, essentially optimal) for the torus's transform; cohomological equation solved with Rüssmann and Cauchy estimates in weighted ℓ¹.

cards.title: Remaining
cards.text: Weighted error, frame and twist, convergence lemma, ℓ¹(ℤ²) algebra (in progress); then the Newton step and the limit torus, giving all-time confinement.

slides.progress: 7 new modules. Constants budget for the KAM step is an informal estimate until the frame and twist certificates land.
slides.boundary: No all-time confinement yet; the torus residual is certified in the sup / unweighted norm only so far.

slides.title: Real coils, certified field lines.
slides.lead: Eight closed polygonal helical filaments plus a closed toroidal-field filament produce a field whose lines, starting near the axis, stay in the confinement tube for a full toroidal transit — proved from the exact Biot–Savart field of straight segments, a certified 6.5×10⁻⁴ frontier error and the vacuum maximum principle.

cards.title: Coil-produced confinement
cards.text: Exact segment fields; C¹ corner parametrization; coils avoid the region; certified frontier error; maximum principle; defect confinement. One transit, zero margin; existence of field lines assumed. Later raised to 52 transits with a cubic-interpolation certificate (error 3.2×10⁻⁶).

cards.title: KAM machinery
cards.text: Quadratic convergence with loss of analyticity, limit lemma, weighted ℓ¹(ℤ²) Banach algebra with Neumann inverses, polynomial composition and Taylor bounds for the torus equation.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: Weighted error and frame/twist certificates, the Newton step and the limit torus (all-time confinement); 10 transits for the coil field needs an ≈ 12× sharper certificate.

slides.progress: 25 new modules; review found the coil chain sound (segment formula, corners, cover, symmetry, avoidance) and led to zero-margin and existence disclosures.
slides.boundary: One transit for the coil field; ≈ 7.5 min / 6 GB certificate build; KAM step pending.

slides.eyebrow: 21 · Phase 9: KAM inputs complete; sheared finite β
slides.title: Error, frame, twist and small divisors — all certified.
slides.lead: For torus A of the exact stellarator field: weighted invariance error ≤ 6×10⁻²² on a complex strip, a symplectic frame with explicit inverse bounds, twist ≥ 3/10, and Diophantine constant 0.0687. A sheared finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibrium joins the library.

cards.title: KAM inputs
cards.text: Weighted residual 5.83×10⁻²² / 3.47×10⁻²² at r = 0.1257; Ω(∂θK, N) = 1, det M ∈ [0.37, 2.86]; ⟨twist⟩ ≥ 3/10. The frame-torsion transport identity is a definition-level assumption to discharge.

cards.title: Sheared finite β
cards.text: Landreman family 2: force balance, flux function, planar elliptic axis, non-axisymmetric; ι ≤ 25/3 on an inner surface and ≥ 17/2 on an outer one (ε = 1/4, S = 4). Part 4: Mercier-unstable (family 1 proved; family 2 numerically).

cards.title: Next: the Newton step
cards.text: Quasi-Newton step with counterterm, iteration to an exact torus, regularity, radial-graph and collar bounds, then all-time confinement via the torus-trapping theorem.

slides.progress: 10 new modules completing the KAM input certificates and adding family 2.
slides.boundary: All-time confinement not yet proved; shear proved for a chosen parameter set, not the paper's example.

slides.title: An exact invariant torus, and field lines trapped for all time.
slides.lead: A verified KAM theorem turns the certified approximate torus (error 10⁻²²) into an exact real-analytic invariant torus of the stellarator field with rotational transform (75 + √5)/562. By the torus-trapping theorem, every field line starting inside it — at least 0.077 R₀ from the axis — stays inside forever.

cards.title: Verified KAM
cards.text: Strip-analytic Fourier algebra, cohomological solver, derived frame identities, flux-average lemma, quasi-Newton step with explicit constants, iteration and C^n regularity. Smallness 1.1×10⁻³ ≤ 1 (margin ≈ 900).

cards.title: All-time confinement
cards.text: ∃ ρ with 0.077 ≤ ρ ≤ 0.19: every two-sided field line of the exact field starting inside stays inside for all t. Global existence and uniqueness of field lines also proved (addendum). Reviewed independently: sound.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: All-time confinement for a coil-produced field; field-line existence; stepped-pressure finite β across the torus; guiding-centre particles.

slides.progress: 17 new modules completing the KAM route; the frame-transport assumption from part 3 is now derived.
slides.boundary: Magnetic field lines in a vacuum model field; not particles, not finite β, not coil-produced.

slides.title: An exact torus for alpha guiding centres; coils need new analysis.
slides.lead: Passing (μ = 0) guiding centres follow field lines of B + ρ_s∇×b. For 3.5 MeV alphas at B₀R₀ ≈ 69 T·m (ρ_s = 1/256) this field has an exact invariant torus, proved with a KAM theorem extended to an inverse-square-root node. The analogous result for the coil-produced field is blocked by a 39-order-of-magnitude gap.

cards.title: Guiding-centre torus
cards.text: Residual ≤ 3.7×10⁻²³, twist ≈ 0.44, node validity 0.286 < 1, smallness margin ≈ 1470; exact analytic torus 10⁻¹²-close; C² real form. Trapping and the alpha corollary were completed next.

cards.title: Coil KAM: blocked
cards.text: Cauchy formula in two variables, complex coil field, Paley–Wiener sampling certificates and a full residual pipeline — but the certified residual is ≈10⁹ against ≈10⁻³⁰ needed. Paused as research.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: All-time confinement of passing alpha guiding centres; sharp complex bounds for coils; finite β across the torus.

slides.progress: About 75 new modules (many certificates); the vacuous coil certificate is committed but excluded from the default build.
slides.boundary: Littlejohn model supplied; μ = 0 only; coil-produced all-time confinement not achieved.

slides.title: Passing 3.5 MeV alpha guiding centres never leave the torus.
slides.lead: With the exact torus of the guiding-centre field B + (1/256)∇×b and B*∥ = |B|, every μ = 0 Littlejohn orbit of a 3.5 MeV alpha with v∥ > 0 that starts inside the torus — in the stellarator field scaled to B₀R₀ ≈ 69 T·m — stays inside for all time, and such orbits exist from every interior point.

cards.title: The theorem
cards.text: alpha_gc_confined_forever: CODATA-rounded mass and charge, B₀R₀ ∈ [68.9, 69.0] T·m, trapping region 0.03 ≤ ρ/R₀ ≤ 0.253; existence and all-time confinement. Reviewed independently: sound. Extended to v∥ < 0 (alpha_gc_confined_forever_pm, second torus with ι_B).

cards.title: Scope — read this
cards.text: Measure-zero set of alphas: μ = 0, full parallel energy, either sign of v∥ (separate tori), one exact B₀R₀; Littlejohn model supplied; non-relativistic; no collisions or E-field; vacuum model field, not coils. Not alpha confinement in general.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: KAM over a parameter interval in ρ_s (robust in energy and B₀R₀); v∥ < 0; μ > 0.

slides.progress: 7 new modules finishing the guiding-centre route (generic FlowTorus layer, star-shapedness certificates, orbit-to-field-line reduction).
slides.boundary: Measure-zero alpha population; supplied guiding-centre model.

slides.title: A family of exact tori over a range of B₀R₀.
slides.lead: A Chebyshev-in-ρ family of approximate tori, certified uniformly by Kronecker-ball arithmetic, gives an exact invariant torus of the guiding-centre field for every ρ_s in an interval — hence all-time confinement of passing alpha guiding centres for every B₀R₀ ∈ [67.95, 69.99] T·m. A second torus covers v∥ < 0.

cards.title: Robust in B₀R₀
cards.text: Uniform KAM constants over the cell (smallness 0.073); profile 0.03 ≤ P ≤ 0.255; ≈ 15 CPU-minutes. Reviewed independently: sound.

cards.title: Both signs, μ > 0 identity
cards.text: ι_B torus for v∥ < 0; for μ > 0 passing orbits the grad-B drift is absorbed exactly into B + ∇×(ρ_{E,μ}b) — the KAM torus for that field is next.

cards.title: Trapped alphas
cards.text: Exact-QA all-time; near-QA 1.8×10⁻⁴ s proved; bounce period ≤ 83 μs; the re-anchored bound cannot close with absolute amplitudes — oscillatory enclosure in progress.

slides.progress: About 90 new modules (mostly certificates).
slides.boundary: Still μ = 0 for confinement theorems; supplied guiding-centre model.

slides.title: Finite pressure, no axisymmetry — and Mercier-stable.
slides.lead: Landreman family 2 at λ = 200 is Mercier-stable on every flux surface k ∈ [0.7, 0.9], certified by validated quadrature with a fully proved checker. The surfaces have a magnetic hill; shear stabilizes them at low β.

cards.title: Stable band
cards.text: D_Merc > 0 on k ∈ [0.7, 0.9] for both signs and all pressure scales; force balance with positive pressure; rejection fixtures at the axis and λ = 15.

cards.title: Caveats
cards.text: Supplied Mercier formula (local interchange); flux labels and area element hand-derived from the paper (numerically checked to 7–15 digits); low β ≈ 3×10⁻⁴.

cards.title: Trapped alphas
cards.text: Certified kick bound 0.0816 (< 0.13 needed), period 59–72 μs; one-bounce remainders remain — parked as research.

slides.progress: About 40 new modules; review found the checker sound and the label gap, now disclosed.
slides.boundary: Low β; change of variables unformalized; no ballooning for this band yet.

slides.title: Theory, techniques and a ladder of models — for confinement and for heat.
slides.lead: Each cycle develops theory, turns theorems into sound certificate checkers, and applies them to the next rung of a model ladder. Every rung must prove properties of both kinds: confinement (G1) and temperature held above burn conditions (G2).

cards.title: Theory tracks
cards.text: Done in Lean: vacuum maximum principle (T1); Sturm/ballooning/Mercier (T2); parabolic comparison and barriers (T3, semilinear); 0-D power balance (T4); SBP discrete energy (T5); radii-polynomial validation, 1-D (T6); guiding centre and averaging (T8). Open: quasilinear D(T), 2-D validation, island widths/KAM (T7), bounce action J_∥, commuted energy (T9).

cards.title: Model ladder
cards.text: M0 exact symmetric equilibria (done) → M1 0-D burning plasma → M2 radial transport on the exact geometries → M3 validated toroidal equilibrium → M4 near-axis quasisymmetry → M5 coil-produced 3-D field → M6 integrated candidate.
cards.status: M0–M2 checked (idealized); M3 (slab) and M4 (0.11 s) in progress

cards.title: Corrections first
cards.text: Four corrections to recent notes. Vacuum |B| has no interior maximum (minima are possible). The flux-surface line bundle is flat. 2-D ideal-MHD regularity is open. Contracts no theorem produces are vacuous.

cards.title: Proof engineering
cards.text: A new skill: grind and fun_induction for short proofs, bv_decide only when no native axiom results, and large certificates built as explicit proof terms (the SubsetSum pattern).

slides.progress: Phases 1–4 met their acceptance criteria in idealized models. The plan's status marks and progress log are updated after each phase.
slides.boundary: Nothing in the plan counts as evidence until a dated report records compiled Lean results.

slides.title: The next run must leave evidence, not just a promise.
slides.lead: Next: all alpha energies 0–3.5 MeV; μ > 0 passing tori (positive measure in velocity space); trapped-alpha oscillatory enclosure; a Mercier-stable finite-β region; sharp complex bounds for coil KAM.

cards.title: Implement & challenge
cards.text: Choose a scoped theorem or candidate milestone, retain explicit assumptions, and test limiting cases and counterexamples.

cards.title: Compile & audit
cards.text: Build the Lean library and run the axiom audit. Record actual results and remaining physical/model gaps.

cards.title: Report & refresh
cards.text: Update the dated report, task status, this slideshow and the brief README summary after every run, including stalled runs.

slides.progress: The linked run records checked declarations, assumptions and validation. This slideshow is a summary of that evidence, not a new design certificate.
